entities.summary: Juan Velasco Alvarado, a notable figure in the history of Peru, associated with Reform, Revolution, and Military Government (1968–1980). Preceded by Velasco's coup begins revolutionary military government — October 3, 1968 and Mariátegui publishes 'Seven Interpretive Essays on Peruvian Reality'. Their legacy influenced Agrarian Reform Law breaks up haciendas and Quechua recognized as official language.
